title: Derived tensor preserves locally constant finite type cohomology
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] and $B$ a commutative Noetherian ring. If $K,L\in D^-(\mathcal C,\underline B)$ have all cohomology sheaves locally constant of finite type, then every cohomology sheaf of $K\otimes_B^L L$ is locally constant of finite type. Here constants are [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], derived categories and cohomology are [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves], and Noetherian means [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]; locally constant of finite type means locally isomorphic to the constant sheaf of a finitely generated module. No existence of points of the site is assumed. Here $D^-$ denotes objects whose cohomology vanishes in sufficiently high degrees, and $K\otimes_B^L L$ denotes the total tensor complex [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] after replacing the factors by K-flat resolutions [def-pc-kflat-complex].
